info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Commission Agreement Management API
info.description: The Commission Agreement Management API facilitates the creation of commission agreements between sales agents and the banking institution. It allows authorized users to efficiently configure and submit new agreements, ensuring compliance with internal policies and regulations. Typically used by sales teams and finance departments, this API streamlines the onboarding process for agents by standardizing agreement terms and automating workflows. Integration with existing systems enhances operational efficiency and supports transparent agreements that benefit both the institution and its agents.

post.summary: Create a new sales commission agreement.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new sales commission agreement. You can specify the parameters in the request body to set up the commission structure for sales representatives.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create or modify a sales commission agreement. It expects a JSON payload containing the details of the commission agreement.

201.description: The commission agreement was successfully created.
